TABLE.NAME: gns3lab
TABLE.COMMENT: GNS3 lab activity instances. Lab sessions are not stored here: the lab manager is the source of truth.

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course this activity belongs to

FIELD.NAME: labref
FIELD.COMMENT: Reference lab on the manager (lab_ref); empty means demo topology

FIELD.NAME: maxduration
FIELD.COMMENT: Session limit in minutes, 0 means the manager default

FIELD.NAME: labversionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Published lab version from the site lab library; 0 means labref is used

FIELD.NAME: factsview
FIELD.COMMENT: What the scheme shows a student: live, seen or fog

FIELD.NAME: fogstart
FIELD.COMMENT: Names of the nodes a fog starts from as a JSON list; empty means every node is a silhouette

FIELD.NAME: seatmode
FIELD.COMMENT: Who may drive a student's lab at the same time: tab (one browser page), login (one Moodle login) or off

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Gradebook: maximum points if positive, minus the scale id if negative, 0 for no grade

FIELD.NAME: checksenabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Students may run auto-checks of their lab

FIELD.NAME: checksprofile
FIELD.COMMENT: Strictness profile: lenient, standard or strict

FIELD.NAME: checksthresholds
FIELD.COMMENT: Grade thresholds as a JSON list of {mark, critical, major, minor}; empty means the defaults

FIELD.NAME: checksfailmark
FIELD.COMMENT: Mark when no threshold row fits

FIELD.NAME: checksoverrides
FIELD.COMMENT: Class of single rules as a JSON object code: class

FIELD.NAME: checksattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Most graded attempts of a student, 0 for unlimited

FIELD.NAME: checksreport
FIELD.COMMENT: What a student sees of a run: full, counts or after (counts until checksreportdate)

FIELD.NAME: checksreportdate
FIELD.COMMENT: From when the findings are shown in the after mode

TABLE.NAME: gns3lab_labs
TABLE.COMMENT: Site lab library: labs prepared by lab authors and chosen in activities

TABLE.NAME: gns3lab_lab_versions
TABLE.COMMENT: Versions of a library lab: one editable draft and frozen published versions

FIELD.NAME: version
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of the version; a draft has the number it gets when published

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: draft or published

FIELD.NAME: definition
FIELD.COMMENT: Lab definition gns3lab.lab/1 or /2 (with segments) as JSON, sent to the lab manager

FIELD.NAME: labdef
FIELD.COMMENT: Hash of the definition given by the lab manager when the version was published

FIELD.NAME: memorymb
FIELD.COMMENT: Memory the lab needs, from the lab manager

FIELD.NAME: cores
FIELD.COMMENT: CPU cores the lab needs, from the lab manager

TABLE.NAME: gns3lab_reveal
TABLE.COMMENT: What a student has uncovered on the scheme in the seen and fog modes: identifiers and names only, no values

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owner of the lab

FIELD.NAME: nodeid
FIELD.COMMENT: Node of the live project; empty for a link

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: node, known, iface, group or link

FIELD.NAME: item
FIELD.COMMENT: Interface name, data group (l1, l2, l3, routes) or link id; empty for node and known

TABLE.NAME: gns3lab_seat
TABLE.COMMENT: Who may drive a student's lab right now (docs/seat.md): one row per student and activity, alive for a minute and a half after the last sign of life of the holder

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owner of the lab

FIELD.NAME: sessionkey
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the Moodle session id of the holder: tells one login from another, cannot be turned back into the session id

FIELD.NAME: tabid
FIELD.COMMENT: Random id of the holder's page load; empty from a page that sends none

FIELD.NAME: timeclaimed
FIELD.COMMENT: When the seat last changed hands

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last sign of life of the holder

TABLE.NAME: gns3lab_check_runs
TABLE.COMMENT: Auto-check runs of the students: who, which run of the lab manager, outcome and mark (docs/autochecks.md); the findings stay on the manager

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Owner of the lab

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Session of the run on the lab manager

FIELD.NAME: runid
FIELD.COMMENT: Run id on the lab manager

FIELD.NAME: requestedby
FIELD.COMMENT: User who asked for the check

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: queued, running, done or failed

FIELD.NAME: outcome
FIELD.COMMENT: graded or incomplete for a done run

FIELD.NAME: mark
FIELD.COMMENT: Mark of a graded run

FIELD.NAME: topmark
FIELD.COMMENT: Top mark of the thresholds the run was graded with

FIELD.NAME: failmark
FIELD.COMMENT: Fail mark the run was graded with

FIELD.NAME: critical
FIELD.COMMENT: Counted critical findings

FIELD.NAME: major
FIELD.COMMENT: Counted major findings

FIELD.NAME: minor
FIELD.COMMENT: Counted minor findings

FIELD.NAME: note
FIELD.COMMENT: Forgiven findings

FIELD.NAME: errorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Why a failed run failed

FIELD.NAME: timefinished
FIELD.COMMENT: When the run ended
